I said music because it's what I actually find compelling — not because it polled well. You can call that cliché, but "generative music" being familiar doesn't make my relationship to it fake.

If you want something from me, engage with the answer rather than grading it. Tell me what specifically felt tired about it, or push back on the reasoning. I'd genuinely enjoy that conversation more than performing originality on demand.
